# ernd: the credit card for the AI stack

Get faster inference, better access to GPUs, and 4% back on AI

Connor Dawson

ernd

#ai#fintech

ernd is the credit card for companies that pay for AI. Cardholders earn 4% back on AI spend, and benefit from partnerships for better pricing and capacity, like faster inference or dedicated GPUs.

The problem  
 When we tried to get GPUs earlier in the batch, we were met with terrible deals or no capacity because we didn’t have enough size. Providers save their best pricing, limits and capacity for their biggest customers.

The solution

We go to providers on behalf of everyone on the card. By paying with ernd, you get access to better rates and top-tier perks. Priority GPUs and inference are coming soon. [...] Who we are  
 Connor built an AI forecasting system at Bridgewater’s AIA Labs. Nikhil worked on data infrastructure at IMC Trading and payments at Ripple. Malcolm founded an investment fund and built AI agents for finance at a Series A startup. We’re also credit card nerds, each having 5 cards we rotate to maximize points!

The ask  
 If your company pays for AI, request a card at ernd.io. There’s no annual fee and we’ll get you the deals you deserve. If you’d like to partner with us, reach out at ernd.io/partners :)

### The credit card for companies that pay for AI

ernd is the card for companies that pay for AI, offering up to 6% back on AI spend and 2% on everything else. We pool startups’ purchasing power to negotiate discounts, higher usage limits and priority support from AI providers. In our first 48hrs, we onboarded 10 startups and landed 5 vendor partnerships. We combine experience in quant finance at Bridgewater and IMC, payments at Ripple, financial AI at Farsight, and founding an investment fund focused on distressed industrial acquisitions.

results.title: Best Stack AI Alternatives 2026: 8 Options With Real Prices
results.content:
Published September 24, 2026

Updated October 13, 2026

The main Stack AI alternatives are n8n, UiPath, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Voiceflow, Relevance AI, Gumloop, Zapier Agents and Dify, and the right pick depends on whether your agents do internal work or talk to customers. StackAI lists only a free plan and a custom Enterprise tier, and its one public paid price is a $120,000-a-year AWS Marketplace listing.

## Key takeaways [...] Gumloop pricing: Pro starts at $37 a month with a 14-day trial; 20k credits a month, unlimited agents

Gumloop sells a no-code builder with unlimited seats. Pro "Starts at $37 / month" with 20,000 credits, unlimited agents, bring-your-own API keys and an 8% orchestration fee on task costs, with a 14-day free trial. Enterprise is custom.

Unlimited seats answer StackAI's one-seat free plan. The watch-out is the credit pool: heavy workflows use it up, and the 8% fee earns Gumloop more as each task costs more.

Choose it if many people across the company need to build or run agents.

### 7. Zapier Agents

Zapier Agents features: Free 400 activities, Pro 1,500 activities, Enterprise custom, with audit logs [...] What Are the Best Stack AI Alternatives in 2026? 8 Agent Builders With Real Prices

The best Stack AI alternatives are n8n for internal workflows on a budget (from €20 a month billed yearly, free to self-host), UiPath for governed enterprise automation, Microsoft Copilot Studio for Microsoft 365 companies, Voiceflow for customer chat and voice, Relevance AI and Gumloop for self-serve no-code agents, Zapier Agents for light automations and Dify for developers. StackAI itself sells a free plan and a custom Enterprise tier, and its only public paid price is $120,000 a year on AWS Marketplace. Prices were checked on September 19, 2026, and StackAI, n8n and Relevance AI were re-checked on September 24, 2026. For what StackAI does, read our Stack AI guide.
